title: Russian Buckwheat Blini
description: A traditional Russian breakfast dish featuring buckwheat pancakes served with a yeasty twist.
instructions: Combine buckwheat flour and Russian yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add in water, stirring until a smooth batter forms.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let the batter rest in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
